title: From SAM to DINOv2: Towards Distilling Foundation Models to Lightweight Baselines for Generalized Polyp Segmentation (PolypDiFoM)
mechanism: Distil semantic priors of SAM / DINOv2 into U-Net / U-Net++ encoders with frequency-domain encoding, keeping the cheap model for deployment.
adaptation: House U-Net++ R34 + cosine feature-alignment loss at layer3/layer4 to frozen DINOv3-L or SAM2 features computed at 1024 and pooled to encoder stride; labelled + 11.9k pool cells.
min_experiment: House PF + distillation (weights 0.1 and 1.0) vs house PF, 5 seeds; pass if E1 crack relF1@2 +0.03 with CV loss <= 0.005.
evidence: R: beats U-Net / U-Net++ baselines and SOTA on 5 polyp sets with about 9x less compute.
prior_overlap: SSL with foundation-model teachers listed as not closed; distillation never tried.
